about: Real Curve Router NG exchange transactions (public, read-only): calldata from eth_getTransactionByHash, gasUsed from eth_getTransactionReceipt (on Arbitrum less gasUsedForL1, the L1 component), sampled on 2026-11-28 by route shape (up to 2 per shape and chain, one per sender) from the routes this module builds. No endpoint is recorded.
